title: Blush Framework extension manifest
description: A local extension's extension.json: its name, service provider, and the classes autoloaded for it.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

name.description: The extension's name: a lowercase slug, or vendor/name.

provider.description: The class name of the extension's service provider.

psr-4.description: Namespace prefixes, each ending in a backslash, and the folders inside the extension their classes are in, such as {"Acme\\Gallery\\": "src/"}.

requires.description: What the extension needs, by name, with Composer-style version constraints: php, blush, ext-{name} for PHP extensions, and other extensions.
